item.title: Living in Fort Meade, Maryland: Your Guide to Military Community Life
item.description:
Welcome to Fort Meade, Maryland

Estimated reading time: 5 minutes

Your First Look at Fort Meade

Fort Meade is unlike any other community in Anne Arundel County. This isn’t a typical suburb—it’s a major U.S. military installation that also serves as a residential community for military personnel, Department of Defense civilians, and their families. The installation is home to critical national security agencies including the National Security Agency (NSA) and U.S. Cyber Command.

item.title: Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County

Military Installations & Communities

Major Military Installations

Naval Academy (Annapolis):

Basic Facts:

  • Location: 110 Taylor Avenue, Annapolis, MD 21402
  • Phone: 410-293-0111
  • Website: www.usna.edu
  • Population: ~4,500 midshipmen, 600+ faculty/staff
  • Founded: 1845

Community Impact:

  • Major employer in Annapolis
  • Tourism and economic benefits
  • Strong military-civilian community ties
  • Many civilians work at Naval Academy

Housing:

  • OCS (Officer Career School): Some housing available
  • Bachelors: Limited, typically unmarried
  • Families: Most live off-base in Annapolis/neighborhoods
  • On-base housing: Apply through Housing Office

item.title: Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
Veterans & Military Resources in Anne Arundel County

Estimated reading time: 6 minutes

Anne Arundel County has a significant military presence, with Fort Meade (NSA headquarters), Joint Base Andrews, and Naval Academy nearby. If you’re a veteran or military family, there are plenty of resources available - but you need to know where to look and what’s actually available to you.

Military Installations Nearby

Fort Meade

Home to the National Security Agency and major military commands. This is the largest military installation in the county.

item.title: Tricare Health Insurance for Military Families
item.description:
Tricare Health Insurance for Military Families

If you’re military or a military family member living in Anne Arundel County, Tricare provides your health insurance. This guide covers your options near Fort Meade, Naval Academy, and Joint Base Andrews.

Tricare Options

Tricare Prime

Best For: Active duty service members and families

Features:

  • No monthly premium (for service members)
  • $0-200 per person annual enrollment fee (for families)
  • Choose primary care manager (PCM)
  • Referrals needed for specialists
  • Low copays for care
  • Comprehensive coverage
